paragraphs: Pika Labs has grown from a single short-form video model into an all-in-one creative studio. Generate multi-shot videos up to 3 minutes with sound, build consistent characters, grade color, score scenes with Pika Soundtrack, and tap 100+ models through the $10/month Pika API Club — all from one workspace.

Pika began as an AI video generator built on its own proprietary model. In 2026 it rebuilt itself as a comprehensive AI creative platform — a set of focused apps for video, image, character and audio work that automatically route each job to the best model for the task, whether that's Pika 2.5 , Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3, Wan 3.0, GPT Image 2.5 or Nano Banana 2.

Alongside the studio, Pika ships its own frontier audio models (Music, Soundtrack, SFX and Speech), a developer-facing API Club with wholesale-level pricing on 100+ models, and an MCP toolkit that lets agents like Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT generate media directly. The classic Pika tools — Pikaframes, Pikaswaps, Pikadditions, Pikaffects and Pikaformance — still live inside the platform.
Available on web, iOS and Android, with a free tier and one-time credit packs so you never need a subscription to get started.
The busiest year in Pika's history: real-time agents in spring, a developer API Club and four audio models in summer, and a full platform rebuild in September. Here's the timeline, then the details.
Studios report five-figure monthly savings building anime, short dramas and global campaigns.
Video, image and audio apps in one interface with automatic model routing.
Soundtrack, Music, SFX and Speech — "the lowest-priced audio models on the market."
$10/mo membership, 100+ models, up to 88% cheaper than other aggregators.
Open-source prototypes workshop and four MCP skills for launching a product.
Real-time video chat for agents, and AI Selves that earn tokens redeemable for cash.
Video Studio, Character Studio, Color Grade, Product Shot and Soundtrack — with the right model picked for you.

On September 17, 2026 Pika relaunched pika.art as a multi-app studio. Instead of one prompt box, you get purpose-built apps that route each request across Seedance 2.5, Pika 2.5, MiniMax H3, Wan 3.0, Google Omni Flash, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana 2, Grok Imagine and Pika's own audio models. Existing accounts, plans and creations carried over automatically. Power users can still hand-pick a model; everyone else just describes the result.
"We were shocked by the 3x markup on API aggregators. So we built our own."

The Pika API Club is a membership that unlocks wholesale-level, pay-as-you-go pricing on video, image, audio, speech and LLM models — Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, FLUX 3, Seedream 5, GPT Image 2, ElevenLabs, Claude and Gemini among them. Members get $10 of usage credit in their first month and can cancel anytime. It's built "agent-native" so Claude, Cursor, Codex and Lovable can call it without parsing docs.
Four foundation sound models, priced up to 20× below comparable alternatives.

Pika's first audio drop covers the whole soundscape: Pika Soundtrack scores silent video with motion-aware effects, music, ambience and voice; Pika Music writes full tracks up to six minutes from text, lyrics or references; Pika SFX renders a sound effect in under a second; and Pika Speech clones a voice from five seconds of audio at a 0.02 real-time factor. See the Pika Audio section for specs.
Brand, app-store screens, sizzle video and founder video — from inside your agent.

Install the Pika MCP (pika.me/mcp) and your agent can run the Build-a-Brand skill (positioning, logo, type, palette), generate App Store Screens from Figma or brand guidelines, cut a 15-second App Sizzle Video from screenshots or a store link, and produce a Founder Video from a selfie. It pairs with Pika Experiments, an open workshop that shipped a generative-UI prototype the same week.
A face and a voice for your agent — live, with memory that persists.

PikaStream 1.0 lets agents respond live on a video call, adapting to tone and context while keeping memory and personality across sessions. Pair it with a Pika AI Self and the agent can run tasks during the call.
Persistent. Portable. Multi-modal.

Build a personal AI Self trained on your personality, voice and appearance. It chats, creates content and travels with you across messaging apps — and since April it can accumulate tokens redeemable for cash every time someone uses it. See Earn below.
The September 2026 relaunch replaced a single prompt box with purpose-built apps. Each one is self-contained, picks the best model for the job, and hands off cleanly to the next.
Generate a short clip or a 3-minute multi-shot sequence with sound. Attach up to 50 characters, products, settings and styles and @mention them in your prompt.
Lengthen any footage by generating new frames that continue the motion, lighting and subject of the original.
Shift mood, contrast and palette on generated or uploaded video — a LUT you describe instead of build.
Replace, remove or restyle any element in an image with GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana 2 or Seedream 5.
Create reusable characters that stay consistent across images, shots and whole videos.
Styled product photography and video without a set — drop in your product and describe the campaign.
